title: Appointed as Assistant
original: It's not the duty of a guard to stand here and do nothing. Why don't we chat a bit?

title: Talk 1
original: With perfect positioning and a suitable environment, my letters will arrive just fine. After all, it's my job, right? I need to do well to survive.

title: Talk 2
original: Are you hungry? If you want something to eat, just say the word. I can't compete with Matterhorn in the kitchen, but I can at least cook a decent meal.

title: Talk 3
original: The comms equipment here at Rhodes Island is way too good. At this rate, I'm going to lose my job...

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Anything else you need? Just don't keep me on the line for too long.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Huh? There's a faint smell on the letters? No, you must be imagining things.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I owe my life to Master SilverAsh. If necessary, I would do anything for him.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You want me to transport... all these? That's a lot, Doctor! Come on, I'm not a miracle worker!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Seems I'm no match for you. I suppose it's time to retire my business smile for now... *Ahem*... I'd like to show you my true face, from now on.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, there's a new message for... Ah, never mind.

title: Onboard
original: Esteemed Leader of Rhodes Island, your ally—Courier of the Snow Realm—is here at your service. If you get into any sort of trouble during your contract with Master SilverAsh, just snap your fingers and I'll be there.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Whoa, that's an incredible job well done.

title: Promotion 1
original: You'd save a lot of trouble if you sent me onto the battlefield.

title: Promotion 2
original: As a Messenger of the Snow Realm, I'm sure to appear whenever you need me.

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the scouting to me.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I won't blemish the name of the Snow Realm.

title: Depart
original: Too bad some people just can't live and let live.

title: Begin Operation
original: They'll pay for what they've done.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: At your service.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Your orders.

title: Deployment 1
original: Mhmm.

title: Deployment 2
original: Forwards!

title: In Battle 1
original: Attack!

title: In Battle 2
original: How's that?

title: In Battle 3
original: Haaaghh!

title: In Battle 4
original: Speeding up!

title: 4-star Result
original: I'll bring news of our victory to Rhodes Island right away!

title: 3-star Result
original: Let's grab a nice dinner after we clean up the battlefield. My treat!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Anyone injured? I've got medicine and bandages.

title: Operation Failure
original: Let's get out of here first. Here, this way! Hurry!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I'll greet my roommates and neighbors first.

title: Tap
original: How can I help?

title: Trust Tap
original: Alright, I'll whip up a meal for you later.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, I've brought you some food from Kjerag to celebrate the New Year. They're still warm, so would you like to try...? Are they to your taste? D—Don't eat so many! The beastmeat isn't that easy to digest!

title: Greeting
original: Call me whenever you need me.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday! I have a present for you. You'd like to open it now? How about guessing what's inside first? Mm-hm... Correct, it's a scent sachet! I hope when you're carrying it around, you can feel as though I'm by your side.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: It was Master SilverAsh's choice to partner with Rhodes Island, but I believed in his decision. And my days at Rhodes Island have proven not only how right he was, but also how trustworthy you are.
